name: Perranporth Camping & Touring Park
stayType: Campsite with touring pitches and holiday units
accommodation: Grass, electric and hardstanding pitches, plus an apartment, lodges and static caravans
suitableFor: Campers, caravanners, families and dog owners
beachAccess: About a 10-minute, fairly level walk to Perranporth town and beach
confirmedFeatures: Toilets and showers, outdoor swimming pool (seasonal), on-site bar, food vans, laundry
overview: The closest campsite to Perranporth's town and beach, about ten minutes' fairly level walk away. It offers grass, electric and hardstanding pitches as well as an apartment, lodges and static caravans, with a seasonal outdoor pool and an on-site bar.
surfTripFit: Walking to the beach avoids the car-park queues in summer, and the mix of pitches and units suits both campers and van travellers.
